66e4085345587a46.description: The Digital Forensics & Incident Response (DFIR) Consultant is responsible for investigating cybersecurity incidents, conducting digital forensic examinations, and supporting the containment, eradication, and recovery of security threats across customer environments. The role provides specialist technical expertise in incident investigation, evidence preservation, compromise assessments, and advanced threat analysis. Requirements: Digital Forensics & Incident Investigation Conduct digital forensic investigations across endpoints, servers, networks, and cloud environments to identify evidence of malicious activity and security compromise. Acquire, preserve, and analyze digital evidence, including memory, system artifacts, and security logs, to determine incident scope, root cause, and potential impact. Maintain accurate chain-of-custody records and ensure forensic evidence is handled, documented, and preserved in accordance with established procedures. Perform forensic analysis of compromised systems to reconstruct attack timelines, identify indicators of compromise (IOCs), and determine attacker activities. Utilize forensic investigation tools and methodologies to support accurate and defensible technical findings. Incident Response & Threat Containment Lead technical response activities for major security incidents escalated by Level 2 and Level 3 SOC Analysts. Investigate security incidents to determine attack vectors, affected systems, potential exposure, and appropriate remediation actions. Coordinate technical containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident monitoring activities with relevant stakeholders. Conduct compromise assessments to identify indicators of intrusion, unauthorized access, and other suspicious activities across customer environments. Support root cause analysis and post-incident reviews to identify security weaknesses and recommend corrective measures. Malware Analysis & Threat Investigation Perform initial analysis and triage of malware, phishing emails, suspicious files, and exploit artifacts to identify malicious behavior and indicators of compromise. Analyze endpoint, network, and cloud security telemetry to identify attack patterns and potential threats. Investigate suspicious activities across Microsoft 365, Microsoft Entra ID, and other enterprise platforms. Collaborate with Cyber Threat Intelligence teams to incorporate relevant threat intelligence into investigations and response activities. Translate investigation findings into actionable recommendations to improve threat detection and response capabilities. Detection Engineering & Security Improvement Identify opportunities to improve security monitoring and detection capabilities based on forensic investigations and incident findings. Develop and recommend detection logic, including Sigma rules, indicators, and detection use cases, for implementation by Cybersecurity Engineering teams. Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of incident response playbooks, forensic investigation procedures, and operational runbooks. Support the enhancement of Security Orchestration, Automation and Response (SOAR) workflows to improve incident handling efficiency. Collaborate with SOC and Engineering teams to strengthen incident detection, investigation, and response processes. Customer Engagement, Reporting & Compliance Prepare comprehensive technical investigation reports outlining incident timelines, findings, root causes, impact assessments, and recommended remediation actions. Communicate investigation progress, technical findings, and response recommendations to customers and internal stakeholders. Provide clear and actionable guidance to support customer remediation and security improvement activities. Provide technical evidence and investigation findings to the Line Manager to support regulatory notifications, compliance requirements, and formal investigations. Support applicable Saudi Arabian cybersecurity and data protection requirements, including those of the National Cybersecurity Authority (NCA), Saudi Central Bank (SAMA), and Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL), where relevant. Maintain accurate case documentation and ensure investigations are completed in accordance with established operational procedures and service requirements. Our Culture & Code of Conduct: At ZainTECH, we take pride in a culture built on collaboration, innovation, and uncompromising integrity. We are looking for individuals who share these values and are committed to customer-centricity and ethical excellence. All employees are expected to uphold our Code of Conduct, which serves as a guiding framework for responsible behavior across everything we do — from how we work with each other to how we engage with clients and partners globally. Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience in digital forensics, incident response, cybersecurity investigations, or a related field. Practical experience conducting forensic investigations and handling digital evidence using tools such as Velociraptor, KAPE, Volatility, and Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) platforms. Strong understanding of digital forensic methodologies, evidence acquisition, preservation, analysis, and chain-of-custody requirements. Experience analyzing endpoint, server, network, and cloud security logs to investigate security incidents and identify malicious activities. Hands-on knowledge of security investigations involving Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Entra ID. Working knowledge of Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) platforms and security monitoring technologies. Experience using Python or PowerShell for scripting, investigation support, and task automation. Understanding of incident response methodologies, including identification, containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident analysis. Strong analytical, investigative, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to communicate technical findings effectively. Fluency in written and spoken English. Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. Preferred Certifications: GCFA, GCFE, GCIH, or GNFA. GCFR (SANS FOR509) for cloud forensics is a plus.

6695b0f13bfda3ab.description: The role You will be the one designer who owns the student experience. Primarily that means the student app: where students study, work with an AI tutor, answer questions, and take part in activities, including games and head-to-head duels on a topic. You will also shape parts of the live classroom experience. This is a Senior/Principal-level individual contributor Product Designer role. There is no design team underneath you and no manager drawing your roadmap. You take a problem from the first student conversation to the shipped screen, and you decide what to look at next. Why this role One owner of the whole student experience, with a direct line to leadership. Speed: with AI in the workflow, ideas go from research to release in days, not quarters. An experimentation practice being built from the ground up, with you shaping it. A company expanding into more schools, with a long-term ambition to match. What you will do Spend real time with students in Saudi schools. Interviews, focus groups, classroom observation. Turn what you hear into design decisions, and go back to check them. Design for Saudi Arabia, not for the generic "best practice" app. Patterns that work in London or San Francisco often fail here. You know why, and you can show it in your work. Own the student app end to end. Flows, information architecture, prototypes, final UI, and the handover to engineering. Design activities students want to come back to, games and duels included, with learning as the gate: an activity that is more fun but teaches less is a regression. Run experiments. State a hypothesis, build the variants, agree the metric, and read the result honestly. You will help build the experimentation practice, not just use it. Work AI-native. Use AI tools for generation, prototyping and production so your time goes to research and judgement. We care about the quality of your decisions, not how many pixels you pushed by hand. Desired Candidate Profile Roughly 5 years of experience in UX, product design experience. We care less about the number and more about how many people you have interviewed and what you did with it. A research practice you can describe in detail: how you recruit, what you ask, how you synthesise, how it reached the product. A portfolio of projects that demonstrate your creativity and delivery of results through great consumer-facing mobile-first experiences Proficiency in using various tools and techniques to create and communicate your design ideas, such as sketches, wireframes, mockups, prototypes, etc. Experience in conducting user research and testing in different contexts and cultures, using both qualitative and quantitative methods A strong sense of empathy, curiosity, and creativity, and a willingness to learn and experiment

662eb140db89cf0e.description: ممثلة مبيعات – محل بصريات مسؤولة عن استقبال العملاء والترحيب بهم، والتعرّف على احتياجاتهم ومساعدتهم في اختيار النظارات والإطارات والعدسات المناسبة، مع تقديم تجربة شراء مميزة واحترافية. المهام والمسؤوليات: استقبال العملاء والتعامل معهم بأسلوب لبق واحترافي. تقديم شرح واضح عن المنتجات والأسعار والعروض المتاحة. مساعدة العميل في اختيار الإطار والعدسات المناسبة حسب احتياجه. تحقيق أهداف المبيعات الشهرية ومتابعة فرص البيع. ترتيب وتنظيم المنتجات وعرضها بطريقة جذابة. متابعة المخزون والتأكد من توفر المنتجات. تسجيل المبيعات وإتمام عمليات الدفع والفواتير. متابعة طلبات العملاء والتنسيق بشأن الاستلام والتسليم. المحافظة على نظافة وترتيب منطقة العرض وصالة المبيعات. تقديم خدمة ما بعد البيع والتعامل مع استفسارات وملاحظات العملاء. المهارات المطلوبة: مهارات ممتازة في التواصل وخدمة العملاء. القدرة على الإقناع وتحقيق المبيعات. حسن المظهر واللباقة. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق وتحمل ضغط العمل. يفضّل وجود خبرة سابقة في مجال المبيعات أو البصريات.

6631311f0d60be84.description: About the Role HUDSON is seeking a Rotating Equipment Mechanical Engineer – SME to join their team in Yanbu, Medina Province, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position requires 5-10 years of experience and offers a salary range of SAR 8,000 - SAR 10,000 per month. The role involves providing technical expertise for rotating equipment during Reliability Centered Maintenance (RCM), FMEA/FMECA, and various reliability studies. Role Purpose and Context The Rotating Equipment Mechanical Engineer – SME will support the identification of equipment functions, functional failures, failure modes, and failure mechanisms. This includes defining appropriate maintenance strategies aimed at improving reliability, availability, safety, and lifecycle performance of rotating equipment within the operational context. Key Responsibilities Act as the technical authority for rotating equipment during RCM, FMEA, and reliability workshops. Define and validate equipment functions, performance standards, and functional failures. Identify credible failure modes, failure mechanisms, and degradation processes for rotating equipment. Evaluate equipment failure consequences related to safety, environment, production, and maintenance costs. Review equipment history, bad actor reports, vibration data, oil analysis reports, and inspection findings. Recommend appropriate maintenance strategies, including Predictive Maintenance (PdM), Condition-Based Maintenance (CBM), Preventive Maintenance (PM), Failure Finding (FF), and Run-to-Failure (RTF). Assess maintenance intervals based on equipment criticality, failure characteristics, and operating context. Review OEM recommendations and industry best practices. Support Root Cause Failure Analysis (RCFA) for recurring equipment failures. Validate maintenance tasks and spare-parts requirements generated from RCM studies. Identify reliability improvement opportunities and equipment design enhancements. Provide technical guidance on risk mitigation and equipment lifecycle management. Qualifications and Requirements 5-10 years of relevant and verifiable experience in a similar role. Candidates without previous RCM experience may be considered, but under the minimum gross salary. Application Process Interested candidates who meet the requirements are requested to submit their complete documents at the earliest. The application must be provided as ONE SINGLE PDF FILE, containing the updated CV, educational qualification certificates, relevant experience certificates, and a passport copy. Please ensure all submitted documents are clear, complete, and properly arranged within the PDF.

664041e574f9a189.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة سراكو عن مدير أشغال ومرافق عامة للانضمام إلى فريقها في نجران. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية تخطيط وتوجيه وتنسيق أنشطة إدارة المرافق في المنشأة، بما في ذلك الجداول الزمنية لأعمال الصيانة والتنظيف للمواقع المادية الحالية والمستقبلية، والتصاميم، والأثاث. المسؤوليات الرئيسية وضع الخطط والسياسات والاستراتيجيات الإدارية العامة لمرافق الشركة، والإشراف على تنفيذها. ضمان الالتزام بقواعد الصحة والسلامة والبيئة ولوائحها، ومباشرة تنفيذها. مباشرة الأنشطة اليومية للمرافق في المنشأة، بما في ذلك المواقع المادية، والتصاميم والأثاث. تخطيط الجداول الزمنية لأعمال الصيانة والتنظيف للمرافق. مباشرة أنشطة الصيانة، وتنسيق عمليات التصليح لتقليل مدة التوقف عن العمل. اختيار الموظفين وتدريبهم والإشراف عليهم، ومراقبة أدائهم وسلوكهم مقارنةً بالأهداف المحددة. تخطيط أعمال الإنشاء والملحقات الجديدة، وإعداد العقود المتعلقة بالبناء ومراجعتها والموافقة عليها. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين إلى 5 سنوات في مجال إدارة المرافق أو الأشغال العامة. فهم قوي لمبادئ إدارة المرافق والصيانة. القدرة على تخطيط وتنسيق الجداول الزمنية والأنشطة المتعددة. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات قيادية وإشرافية ممتازة. مهارات قوية في التخطيط والتنظيم. القدرة على إدارة المشاريع والعقود. الالتزام بمعايير الصحة والسلامة والبيئة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في نجران، المملكة العربية السعودية. يعمل مدير الأشغال والمرافق العامة ضمن فريق متخصص لضمان سير العمليات بكفاءة وفعالية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة لم يتم الكشف عنه وسيتحدد بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

6669489be0c160af.description: About the Role NTT DATA is seeking a Cybersecurity Consultant TVA to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time role is for a hands-on cybersecurity professional responsible for conducting vulnerability assessments, penetration testing, and security reviews across customer environments. The consultant will work closely with customers, infrastructure teams, application owners, and security stakeholders to identify security weaknesses, validate risks, and provide practical remediation recommendations. The position combines technical security testing, customer engagement, and cybersecurity consultancy to enhance organizational security posture, reduce risk, and improve compliance with security best practices and regulatory requirements. Key Responsibilities Conduct vulnerability assessments and penetration tests across network, infrastructure, server, application, and cloud environments. Perform internal and external network penetration testing within approved scopes and rules of engagement. Conduct web application and API security assessments using recognized industry methodologies and frameworks. Perform authenticated and unauthenticated vulnerability scanning using approved commercial and open-source security tools. Validate vulnerabilities identified by automated tools and remove false positives before reporting. Perform controlled exploitation activities to confirm vulnerability impact while minimizing operational risk. Assess Windows, Linux, Active Directory, databases, network devices, and security infrastructure for security weaknesses. Evaluate vulnerabilities based on exploitability, asset criticality, technical severity, and business impact. Assign risk ratings using CVSS and applicable customer risk-classification methodologies. Prepare technical assessment reports, executive summaries, and remediation recommendations. Present assessment findings and risk remediation plans to technical and business stakeholders. Conduct remediation workshops and provide technical guidance to customer teams. Perform remediation validation and retesting activities. Maintain assessment evidence, testing records, screenshots, tool outputs, and supporting documentation. Support assessment planning activities, including scope definition, methodology selection, and rules of engagement. Ensure all testing activities comply with approved authorization requirements and security testing procedures. Support security consulting initiatives related to system hardening, vulnerability remediation, application security, and infrastructure security. Assist with security assessments aligned to recognized frameworks including NCA ECC, SAMA CSF, ISO 27001, CIS Controls, and PCI DSS. Contribute to continuous improvement of internal security testing methodologies, reporting templates, and knowledge repositories. Support presales activities by providing technical input for customer proposals, assessment scope definitions, and effort estimates. Perform any other cybersecurity consulting, vulnerability management, or penetration testing activities as required. Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of experience in cybersecurity. Strong understanding of vulnerability assessment and penetration testing methodologies. Hands-on experience conducting network, infrastructure, web application, and API security testing. Strong knowledge of TCP/IP networking, routing, switching, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, VPNs, firewalls, and enterprise network services. Good working knowledge of Windows, Linux, and Active Directory environments. Familiarity with common attack techniques including privilege escalation, credential attacks, lateral movement, and Active Directory exploitation. Strong understanding of OWASP Top 10, OWASP API Security Top 10, CVSS, CWE, and MITRE ATT&CK frameworks. Practical experience using security assessment tools such as Burp Suite, Nmap, Nessus, Qualys, Rapid7, Metasploit, Wireshark, OWASP ZAP, and Kali Linux. Ability to manually validate vulnerabilities and distinguish genuine findings from false positives. Understanding of common security technologies including WAF, IDS/IPS, NAC, EDR, SIEM, and secure remote access solutions. Basic scripting capabilities using Python, PowerShell, Bash, or similar languages. Demonstrated experience conducting internal and external network penetration tests. Hands-on experience performing web application and API security assessments. Experience using vulnerability management platforms such as Tenable, Qualys, or Rapid7. Strong working experience with tools including Burp Suite, Metasploit, Nmap, Kali Linux, and Wireshark. Experience performing vulnerability validation, exploitation, remediation verification, and retesting. Experience preparing professional technical security reports and presenting findings to customers and stakeholders. Experience assessing Windows, Linux, Active Directory, network infrastructure, and enterprise environments. Experience working directly with customer engagements within a cybersecurity consulting, systems integration, or professional services environment. Experience with Active Directory security testing is strongly preferred. Cloud, wireless, mobile application, container security, or red team experience is advantageous. Exposure to NCA ECC, SAMA CSF, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, or related security frameworks is considered beneficial. Required Skills Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to think from an attacker's perspective. Strong report writing, evidence documentation, and presentation skills. Ability to communicate technical vulnerabilities and risks to both technical and business stakeholders. Ability to manage multiple customer engagements and work independently while maintaining high-quality deliverables. Strong professional integrity and commitment to maintaining customer confidentiality. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, focusing on direct customer engagements within a cybersecurity consulting, systems integration, or professional services environment. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply to join NTT DATA and contribute to strengthening organizational security postures.

6675d9e57fd1146e.description: About the Role Tractebel is seeking a Senior Design Mechanical Engineer to join our team in Makkah, Saudi Arabia, with responsibilities spanning Jeddah and Makkah. This full-time role involves managing design works, coordinating with contractors and consultants, and ensuring the quality of engineering deliverables for large thermal power projects. Key Responsibilities Prepare specifications for mechanical designs. Coordinate design reviews with relevant stakeholders. Manage design works in collaboration with contractors and consultants. Ensure internal coordination with other engineering disciplines. Oversee all design review activities for base and detailed engineering submittals, drawings, and documents. Evaluate claims and change orders related to mechanical engineering. Contribute to the close-out report for the LSTK Steam Power Plant Gas Conversion Project. Required Experience and Skills Demonstrated experience in mechanical design and engineering. Proficiency in reviewing EPC submitted engineering documents for the Mechanical discipline, including: Master Documents List (MDL) Design criteria, PFDs, P&IDs, GA, HMBD Design calculations and studies, CFD modeling Manuals, FAT procedures and reports (including attending FAT if necessary) Construction, commissioning reliability, and performance test procedures and reports Method statements for construction/installation Vendor materials procurement review Review of proposed vendors/suppliers design/drawings and design documents Design and field changes (as required) As-built drawings, IFC/AFC/AFI drawings, and red markup drawings Studies, Hazop/Hazid/SIL, Risk assessment and mitigation Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, approved by the Saudi Council of Engineers. 66815895cebdaab2.description: Overview of the Role Jacobs Engineering Group Inc. is seeking a Director, Event Mobility Planning to join their team in Riyadh, All SA Regions. This full-time position is critical to a flagship giga project in Saudi Arabia, located approximately 45 km southwest of Riyadh, which is a central pillar of Vision 2030. The role focuses on developing and delivering integrated mobility planning for major events, ensuring safe and efficient movement across venues and districts. Role Purpose and Context The Director, Event Mobility Planning will lead the development and delivery of integrated mobility planning for major events, festivals, sporting competitions, and entertainment activations. This position is responsible for ensuring the safe, efficient, and coordinated movement of guests, athletes, VIPs, workforce, logistics, emergency services, and public transport users. Acting as the City Operations mobility lead, the Director will develop citywide mobility standards, demand forecasts, traffic and event mobility plans, and operational readiness arrangements, supporting major events through 2028 while coordinating with venue and asset operators. Key Responsibilities Lead the development and implementation of event mobility strategy, governance framework, standards, policies, and operating model. Direct integrated mobility planning for major events, festivals, sporting competitions, and entertainment activations across the destination. Develop transport demand forecasts, mobility plans, and arrival/departure strategies for various user groups including guests, VIPs, athletes, and emergency services. Coordinate mobility requirements across multiple concurrent events to optimize network performance, capacity, and operational resilience. Oversee traffic management, access control, road network planning, parking strategies, vehicle accreditation, and emergency access arrangements. Integrate public transport, shuttle services, taxis, ride-hailing, active mobility, and last-mile connectivity into event operations. Develop secure and efficient mobility solutions for VIP, hospitality, protocol, government, and specialist stakeholder movements. Coordinate logistics, servicing, freight, contractor, and emergency service movements to ensure seamless event operations. Lead operational readiness activities, simulations, test events, command-and-control planning, live event mobility operations, and post-event reviews. Manage relationships with government authorities, transport operators, emergency services, event organizers, venues, and suppliers, while overseeing budgets, contracts, procurement, and service performance. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in a relevant field. Demonstrated ability to lead and implement complex mobility planning strategies for large-scale events. Experience in managing relationships with diverse stakeholders, including government bodies and transport operators. Work Environment This role is based at a Jacobs Workplace on a full-time basis, as required by the nature of the position. Jacobs fosters a culture that supports diverse perspectives and provides flexible working arrangements and opportunities for professional growth.

6684bed16fde165b.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة اول النائفات للمقاولات عن ميكانيكي تدفئة وتهوية وتكييف للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور على فحص وصيانة وتصليح أنظمة تمديدات التدفئة والتهوية وتكييف الهواء لضمان كفاءتها التشغيلية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة، وهو متاح بدوام كامل. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تركيب مكونات أنظمة التدفئة والتهوية وتكييف الهواء. تركيب الأنابيب وضبطها وربطها بشكل صحيح. إجراء عمليات التفتيش الروتينية كجزء من الصيانة الوقائية، وتحديد أي أضرار قد تلحق بالمعدات. تصليح واستبدال الأجزاء التالفة أو البالية، واختبار المعدات بعد الانتهاء من التصليح. حفظ السجلات الدقيقة لخدمات المعدات وعمليات التصليح التي تم إجراؤها. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ميكانيكا التدفئة والتهوية وتكييف الهواء. القدرة على فحص وصيانة وتصليح أنظمة التدفئة والتهوية وتكييف الهواء. مهارات جيدة في تركيب المكونات والأنابيب. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في مدينة الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التواجد في الموقع لتنفيذ المهام الموكلة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم للنظر فيها.

66a1688d24f08468.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة تركي بن مقرن للمقاولات عن مدير إدارة مشاريع للانضمام إلى فريقها في حائل. يتولى هذا الدور الإشراف العام على أنشطة إدارة المشاريع والبرامج، ومتابعة عمليات تطوير خطط التنفيذ ومراقبة سير العمل فيها. يهدف الدور إلى ضمان إنجاز المشاريع بكفاءة وفعالية ضمن الجداول الزمنية والميزانيات المحددة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية الإشراف على تطوير وتنفيذ خطط المشاريع والبرامج، وتوجيه ومتابعة تقدير الموازنات المالية وتحديد المتطلبات البشرية والتقنية والمعدات اللازمة، وضمان توفيرها في الوقت المناسب وضمن التكلفة المقدرة. الإشراف على تحديد افتراضات المشروع والتداخلات البينية مع مشاريع أو برامج أخرى لضمان الاستغلال الأمثل للموارد المتاحة، وتحديد مخاطر المشروع والخطوات اللازمة لتفاديها وحلها. التنسيق مع فريق العمل لمراجعة الأعمال المنجزة والمراحل المتبقية، والتأكد من الالتزام بنطاق المشروع ومعايير إدارة المشروع المعتمدة ومواصفات الجودة، وإدارة عمليات التغيير بناءً على الخطط الموضوعة. تنسيق ومتابعة عمليات إنهاء المراحل الرئيسية للمشروع وعملية إغلاقه، وتقييم مستوى تحقيق مخرجات المشروع لأهدافه الرئيسية، وضمان نقل المعارف والخبرات وتوثيق الوثائق والتقارير. الإشراف على إعداد تقارير سير المشروع، وتقارير إدارة التحديات والمخاطر، وتقارير قياس مؤشرات الأداء وعوامل النجاح بشكل دوري، ورفعها للأطراف المعنية والإدارة العليا. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في إدارة المشاريع. فهم عميق لعمليات تطوير خطط تنفيذ المشاريع ومراقبة سير العمل. القدرة على وضع وتتبع الموازنات والإجراءات التعاقدية للمشاريع. مهارات ممتازة في تحديد التكاليف ومصادر التمويل. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات قيادية وإشرافية قوية. القدرة على التنسيق الفعال مع فرق العمل والأطراف المعنية. مهارات تحليلية وحل المشكلات لتحديد المخاطر ووضع الحلول. القدرة على إعداد وتقديم التقارير الدورية للإدارة العليا. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في حائل. سيعمل مدير إدارة المشاريع ضمن فريق متخصص في شركة تركي بن مقرن للمقاولات، ويكون مسؤولاً عن الإشراف على مجموعة متنوعة من المشاريع لضمان تحقيق الأهداف المحددة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات. ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة للتقدم لهذه الفرصة.

66c00a32eabc60f0.description: About Jacobs Engineering Group Inc. Jacobs Engineering Group Inc. focuses on solving critical global problems across various sectors, including urban development, environmental resilience, and scientific discovery. The company aims to transform abstract ideas into realities that benefit the world. Role Overview Jacobs is seeking a Senior Engineer - Testing & Commissioning to join the team in Saudi Arabia. This full-time position is available across All SA Regions, specifically in Neom, Tabuk, and Riyadh. The role involves providing contractual leadership for a major program, focusing on electrical and ICT commissioning for water assets. Key Responsibilities Review testing, commissioning, and handover deliverables, including T&C plans, method statements, procedures, Inspection and Test Plans, test records, and O&M documentation, against contractual and technical requirements. Support the resolution of review comments by tracking outstanding items and following up with Contractors to ensure timely and compliant close-out. Identify gaps in Contractor submissions and assess their impact on testing, commissioning, handover, and operational readiness. Assess potential constraints and risks to achieving full contract-compliant testing and commissioning, providing practical and well-justified recommendations to address identified gaps. Review commissioning programs and sequencing, covering pre-commissioning, functional testing, performance testing, integrated systems testing, and trial operations. Witness or support the verification of key tests and commissioning activities as required, ensuring results are properly recorded and accepted. Support the preparation and review of punch lists, defect close-out, completion certificates, and acceptance documentation. Coordinate with Engineering, Construction, Operations & Maintenance, and Asset Management teams to ensure handover requirements and operational readiness needs are met. Support the transfer of as-built documentation, O&M manuals, spares, training records, and asset data to the receiving Operator. Provide technical input for engineering-related change requests, variations, non-conformances, and queries concerning testing and commissioning. Report on T&C and handover progress, outstanding issues, and risks to project leadership. Qualifications and Experience Minimum of 10 years of experience in testing, commissioning, and handover of major infrastructure, utilities, building, or industrial projects. Strong technical knowledge of commissioning processes across mechanical, electrical, ICT, and Instrumentation & Control systems, including integrated systems testing. Proven experience in reviewing Contractor T&C and handover deliverables against contract and technical requirements. Demonstrated ability to identify gaps, assess risks and constraints, and recommend practical solutions where full contract compliance may be challenging. Sound understanding of operational readiness, asset handover, completion, and acceptance processes. Knowledge of relevant international codes, standards, and commissioning guidelines (*, IEC, NFPA, ASHRAE, CIBSE). Experience on major programs or giga-projects in the GCC is preferred. Required Skills Good stakeholder management and coordination skills, with the ability to work effectively with Contractors, Engineering, Construction, and Operations teams. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare clear review comments, technical assessments, and reports. Proficiency in document management platforms (*, Aconex), commissioning management tools, and MS Office. Application Information This is a full-time position. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

66c9521cf397face.description: Job Purpose HanmiGlobal is seeking a highly qualified Procurement Manager to join our program management and PMCM team in Saudi Arabia. In this role, you will spearhead the program-wide procurement frameworks and sourcing strategies for a mega multi-work package land and infrastructure development program in Riyadh, delivered on behalf of a major government entity. You will be providing program-level leadership, governance, coordination, and commercial oversight for all procurement and tendering activities across the program, ensuring all sourcing plans, supplier management systems, long-lead item strategies, and supply chain risks are fully integrated and aligned with project schedules, technical requirements, contractual obligations, and the Client’s overall program objectives, while supporting the successful delivery of the overall development program. Reports To: Program Director Key Responsibilities Develop and maintain the Program Procurement Management Framework, including procurement policies, procedures, standards, templates, governance processes, and reporting requirements. Establish procurement strategies, sourcing approaches, and performance monitoring systems while ensuring compliance with contractual, regulatory, and corporate procurement requirements. 66155a0485519ba8.description: At Müller's Solutions, we are seeking an Infrastructure Software Sales Specialist specializing in RedHat and Rancher to join our dynamic sales team. In this role, you will be responsible for driving sales efforts for our infrastructure software solutions, focusing on RedHat and Rancher products. Your ability to communicate the value of our offerings to potential clients will play a crucial role in expanding our market presence and achieving sales targets. Key Responsibilities: • Identify and pursue new sales opportunities within the infrastructure software sector. • Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders and decision-makers to drive the sales process. • Develop and deliver engaging product presentations and demonstrations of RedHat and Rancher solutions. • Collaborate with the technical team to understand customer requirements and provide effective solutions. • Conduct market research to stay updated on trends and competitors in the infrastructure software industry. • Achieve and exceed sales targets through effective account management and business development strategies. • Provide feedback to the product management team regarding customer needs and industry trends. Requirements: • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business, or a related field. • 3-5 years of experience in software sales, preferably within the infrastructure software market. • Proven experience selling RedHat, Rancher, or similar infrastructure solutions. • Strong understanding of cloud computing, DevOps principles, and containerization technologies. • Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills to articulate value propositions effectively. • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities to identify client needs and provide tailored solutions. • Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team environment. Preferred Qualifications: • Relevant certifications in RedHat, Rancher, or cloud technologies. • Experience with CRM tools to track sales activities and customer interactions. • Familiarity with Agile methodologies and related tools. Why Join Us: Opportunity to work with a talented and passionate team. Competitive salary and benefits package. Exciting projects and innovative work environment.

66b245ea5d6b00fc.description: Position: Senior Speech Therapist Company: ABC Center Job Summary: We are seeking a highly experienced and passionate Senior Speech Therapist to join our team at ABC Center. The Senior Speech Therapist will be responsible for providing advanced assessment, diagnosis, and therapy services to individuals with speech and communication difficulties. The ideal candidate will have extensive knowledge and expertise in a wide range of speech disorders and therapeutic techniques. Key Responsibilities: Conduct comprehensive assessments of clients' communication skills and formulate personalized treatment plans. Provide evidence-based speech therapy interventions for individuals with speech and communication disorders. Monitor and evaluate clients' progress, making necessary adjustments in therapy techniques and goals. Collaborate with a multidisciplinary team to develop and implement effective treatment plans. Provide guidance and mentoring to junior speech therapists and other team members. Stay updated with the latest research, techniques, and developments in the field of speech therapy. Ensure compliance with professional and ethical standards in all aspects of practice. Master's degree in Speech-Language Pathology or related field. Minimum of 5 years of experience as a Speech Therapist. Valid license or certification in Speech-Language Pathology. Expertise in assessing and treating a range of speech and communication disorders. Strong knowledge of evidence-based therapeutic techniques and interventions. Excellent interpersonal, communication, and teamwork skills. Ability to provide guidance and mentorship to junior therapists. Commitment to professional development and staying updated with current research and practices.
